method: Pixel positions of street intersections read by eye off the 25% scans (zoomed 2x), each with the two street names as printed; ground positions are where the two OSM centrelines cross (scripts/cityimport/build/sanborngeo.ts). Pixels are on the whole scan (x right, y down). Accuracy of a reading: about 3-5 px on a detailed sheet (~1-2 m/px), 5-10 px on the key map. Fit: least-squares affine, pixel -> local metres (scripts/cityimport/build/sanborngeo.ts); registered when RMS <= 15 m (key map 60 m). looMaxM: each point predicted from the others.

sheets.why: Not fitted: the main frame has one street line (Ocean Ave) crossing the cross streets; its other edge is the Boardwalk, which OSM does not cross with the streets (they end at it), and the inset (Maple to Oak) is drawn to its own placement. Readings kept in the note: Ocean & Juniper (85,365), Ocean & Magnolia (85,1065), Ocean & Maple (85,1765).

Not fitted: only Maryland Ave crosses the sheet's streets in OSM (three collinear points); Virginia Ave between 15th and 19th is not in OSM today (the bayside here was re-cut), so no second line. Readings: Maryland & 16th (1258,485), & 17th (1258,900), & 19th (1258,1723); Virginia & 16th (388,485), & 19th (388,1723).
